end.summary:
Practised identifying cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere in toys and objects.
Named sphere using a planet and football example.
Identified a red building-block cube and described its square faces.
Counted two flat faces on a cylinder and identified a round candle as a cylinder.
Initially questioned an upside-down cone, then confirmed it was still a cone.
end.parentNote: Aditya practised naming 3D shapes by connecting them to familiar toys and objects. They used examples for sphere, cube and cylinder, and correctly counted the cylinder’s two flat faces. They briefly mixed up whether turning a cone changed its shape, then corrected this by confirming it was still a cone. At home, ask them to find one object for each shape and explain one feature of each.
